body.description: weathered wooden two-story farmhouse with a front porch and mossy roof, post-apocalyptic solarpunk ruin covered in vines with solar panels on the roof, classic JRPG overworld building in 3/4 top-down view: looking down from above you see the angled rooftop on the top portion and the flat front wall below it, footprint sits flat on the ground tiles, both side walls hidden, symmetric, like a building in Pokemon HeartGold or RPG Maker VX, NOT isometric, NO two-sided corner, pixel art, transparent background
